arabic: قَالَ جَابِرٌ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ: كُنَّا إِذَا صَعِدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا، وَإِذَا نَزَلْنَا سَبَّحْنَا.
transliteration: Allahu Akbar (when going up) ... Subhanallah (when going down).
translation: Jabir (RA) said: Whenever we went up a hill we would say Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) and when we descended we would say Subhanallah (Glory is to Allah).
